Founder asked about trial credits and predictable monthly caps vs pure pay-as-you-go. Emphasized simple billing line items (tokens vs embeddings) — dislikes confusing multipliers.

Competitive notes: actively comparing fidelity and hallucination behavior to OpenAI and Anthropic. Will ask devs to run small eval set if pricing + latency look good.

Tone of meetings: pragmatic, cost-aware, wants transparent defaults. Willing to start self-serve if pricing sample shows ~30% savings vs their current OpenAI bill OR equivalent cost with better latency/feature parity.
